# dsh-diagram-design
Diagram Design tools and gallery for DeepSeek Harness: export HTML diagrams to SVG/PNG, import from
draw.io / Mermaid / Excalidraw, validate output, and browse a gallery of 45 diagram types.
## What it does
A DeepSeek Harness bundle with four agent tools and a web gallery panel:
| Tool | What it does |

| `diagram_export` | Export a diagram-design HTML file to a standalone SVG and/or PNG. |
| `diagram_

extract` | Parse a draw.io / Mermaid / Excalidraw file into a normalized digest for redrawing. |
| `
diagram_self_check` | Validate a generated diagram HTML file (accessible-SVG, single-file safety, vi

ewBox). |
| `diagram_doctor` | Diagnose the environment: bundled scripts, python3, Playwright availa
| `diagram_doctor` | Diagnose the environment: bundled scripts, python3, Playwright availability. |

The gallery panel (sidebar "Diagram Gallery") lists the 45 diagram types with
live example previews.
